x.Structure / Material Portfolio: Breadth and depth of flexible packaging structures (films, laminates, pouches) offered, including diverse substrates and formats, enabling tailored solutions for various end-use applications.
x.Barrier, Protection & Performance: Ability to provide high-performance barriers (oxygen, moisture, light) and mechanical properties that protect product integrity, extend shelf life, and meet demanding application requirements.
x.Converting & Manufacturing Excellence: Operational proficiency in printing, lamination, slitting, and pouch-making, ensuring consistent quality, efficiency, and scalability of production processes.
x.Sustainability & Circular Design: Commitment to eco-friendly materials, recyclable or compostable designs, and reduced environmental footprint, aligning with global sustainability trends and customer demands.
x.Regulatory & Food-Contact Compliance: Adherence to global food-contact regulations (e.g., FDA, EU) and safety standards, ensuring materials are safe for direct food contact and compliant across markets.

y.Geographic Coverage: Extent of global presence, including manufacturing sites, sales offices, and distribution networks, enabling supply to customers across multiple regions and continents.
y.Brand / Converter Customer Reach: Strength of relationships with major brand owners and converters, including contract wins, long-term partnerships, and market share within key customer segments.
y.Financial Performance: Revenue growth, profitability, and financial stability, reflecting the company's ability to invest in R&D, expand capacity, and weather market fluctuations.
y.Innovation Roadmap: Pipeline of new products, technologies, and sustainable solutions, with a clear strategy for future development and commercialization to stay ahead of market trends.
y.Capacity & Business Expansion: Planned or recent investments in new production lines, facilities, or acquisitions to increase capacity and enter new markets or segments, signaling growth ambition.
